purpose: Teach: 王道/東京タワー/大相撲/バッター/金メダル/声優/ジョギング/レア

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、王道、絶対、の少年漫画、絶対、好きだよね
lines.en: Riku, you're seriously obsessed with straightforward shonen manga, aren't you?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the question. Playful accusation mixed with affection. Quick tempo, keeping him slightly off-balance. The tone of someone calling out a friend's guilty pleasure without judgment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、東京タワー、絶対、修学旅行で、絶対、行ったぜ、桜
lines.en: Oh come on, you dragged me to Tokyo Tower on that school trip.
lines.style: Quick defensive riposte, eyes sparkling. Bouncing the accusation back with equal levity. Fast-paced, energetic. The rhythm of two people who know exactly how to get a rise out of each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、大相撲、絶対、観たことある?本気で
lines.en: Wait, have you actually ever watched a sumo match?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity cutting through the banter. Slight shift from teasing to real question. Softer attack on the opener. Leans forward slightly—she actually wants to know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、バッター、絶対、ボックス、絶対、緊張するよな、桜
lines.en: That batter's box moment—you get that nervous feeling too, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful, pulling back from the rapid-fire teasing. Quieter, almost reflective. Testing if she understands something he's noticed. Gentle probe beneath the surface. Softer eye contact than before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、金メダル、絶対、目指してるんだろ?本気で
lines.en: You're seriously going for a gold medal, aren't you?
lines.style: Direct, cutting through any deflection. Steady, almost challenging—not mean, but not letting him off easy. The tone of someone who sees him clearly and won't let him minimize himself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、声優、絶対、になりたいって言ってたよな、桜
lines.en: Didn't you tell me you wanted to be a voice actor?
lines.style: Turning the mirror back on her with the same directness. Calm, almost conversational. No accusation—just calling back what she said. The weight of remembering what someone confessed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、ジョギング、絶対、続いてるよな
lines.en: You're still keeping up with that jogging routine, aren't you?
lines.style: Warm recognition. The tone of noticing something difficult that someone's sustained. No fanfare, just acknowledgment. Steady, grounded. Pride without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、レア、絶対、なグッズ、絶対、持ってんな、桜
lines.en: And you've got some seriously rare collectibles you're not even showing people.
lines.style: Playful observation tinged with affection. Light, not accusatory. The satisfaction of knowing something about her she hasn't broadcast. Slight smile in the voice. Tempo returns to the ease between them.
